common.refundPromise: Full refund if the round does not fill
common.noCancel: Purchases cannot be cancelled (full refund if the round does not fill or is aborted)

home.title: Rounds now opening or on sale
home.entryNote: Rounds at ¥500 or less per slot

lottery.subject: Box to be opened
lottery.seedNote: This is the hash of a seed published before sales began. After the round fills, the seed is revealed and anyone can recompute the draw.
lottery.rules: Rules (fixed at the start of sale)
lottery.guaranteeRule: At least 1 card per slot (a slot with no matching cards receives a designated card)
lottery.partitionText: All card numbers are assigned to slots by the draw. A card that comes out at opening belongs to the slot holding that number. If the same number appears more than once, all copies go to the same slot.
lottery.drawPending: Published after the round fills, before opening
lottery.overdueRefund: More than 24 hours have passed since the scheduled opening, so you can choose a refund
lottery.aborted: This round was aborted ({reason}). Your payment will be refunded in full.
lottery.failed: This round did not fill by the end of the sale period. Your payment will be refunded in full.
lottery.noNumbers: No card numbers (guarantee card if there are none)

checkout.paymentTimingValue: At order (credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
checkout.deliveryValue: Kept in your Collection after opening; shipped once you request shipping (shipping fee separate)
checkout.hold: Your slots are held for {minutes} minutes (until {at})
checkout.nightConfirm: Your total for tonight (0:00–6:00) will be {total}. Continue with this purchase?
checkout.monthRemaining: {amount} left until this month's spending limit
checkout.agree: I agree to purchase with the details above

payResult.successBody: Once the round fills, the draw result (the card numbers for your slots) is published before opening.

video.title: Recording
video.noVideo: The recording is published after opening

verify.title: Verify the draw
verify.intro: This round's draw is computed from the hash of a seed (the commitment) published before sales began and the participant list fixed when the round filled. This page repeats the same calculation in your browser and checks whether it matches the published result.
verify.scopeNote: This version does not use an external beacon. What can be confirmed is that the result was computed from the commitment made before sale and the published participant list.

checks.assignment: Card numbers for all slots match
checks.final: final (computed from seed and participants) matches

verify.notYet: This round has not filled or been drawn yet, so it cannot be verified
verify.publicIntro: Enter a round number to see the public opening record and its verification. No login is required.
verify.tamper: Tamper test (swap one item and verify)

collection.title: Collection
collection.photo: Photo of the actual card (scanning station camera)

ship.title: Request shipping
ship.insured: Insured delivery (because it includes SR or higher; cannot be changed)
ship.couponMin: A free-shipping coupon can be used for shipments of 3 or more items
ship.paid: Your shipping request has been received
ship.forced: Shipped because the storage period ended

suspendReason.ADDRESS_REQUIRED: A delivery address must be registered
suspendReason.PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: Your payment method must be updated

limits.title: Spending limits
limits.intro: These settings help you avoid overspending. Lowering a limit takes effect immediately; raising a limit takes effect after 72 hours.
limits.night: If your total late at night (0:00–6:00) would reach ¥10,000 or more, a confirmation screen is shown before purchase.
limits.selfExclusion: Pausing your account (7 / 30 / 90 days) is coming soon

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.note: Card details are stored by the payment processor (Stripe) and are not saved by BOXラッシュ.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.rules: Coupons can only be used toward shipping fees. They cannot be purchased, transferred, or exchanged for money. One coupon per shipment, usable for shipments of 3 or more items.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.fulfilment: Purchase, opening, and shipping notices (cannot be turned off)

help.title: Help
help.fairness1: The hash of the draw seed is published before sales begin (it cannot be changed afterward).
help.fairness2: After the round fills and the participant list is fixed, the seed is revealed and the draw is run.
help.fairness3: Anyone can repeat the same calculation in a browser or with a script.
help.fairness4: Opening is fully recorded at the set time, and each card's attribution links to a time in the recording.
help.contact: If this does not solve your problem, please contact us

support.title: Contact us
support.subject: Subject
support.appealNote: While an appeal is open, shipping of the cards in that slot is paused.

legal.title: Terms and legal notices
legal.tokushoho: Notice under the Specified Commercial Transactions Act (特定商取引法に基づく表記)
legal.draft: * This text is a draft and not yet final (under legal review).
legal.minors: If you are a minor, please use this service only after obtaining the consent of your legal representative.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: Deleting your account removes it and your personal information. Published opening records keep only a per-round pseudonym.
deleteAccount.stored: You have {n} card(s) in storage. Please ship them or give them up before deleting your account (they cannot be exchanged for money).
deleteAccount.abandon: Give up stored cards and delete account

welcome.title: New here?
welcome.s1t: Opened only after the round fills
welcome.s1: A box is opened only when every slot is sold. If the round does not fill by the deadline, you are refunded in full.
welcome.s2: Once the round fills, the draw is held and each slot's card numbers are published before opening.
welcome.s3: Every opening is recorded, and anyone can recompute the draw.
welcome.s4t: Cards kept in storage and shipped together
welcome.s4: Free storage for 30 days. Cards from several rounds can be shipped in one parcel (shipping is paid by you).
welcome.limitsHint: Default spending limits are set (¥50,000 per month, ¥10,000 per order). You can change them on My page.
